statements.sql: BEGIN
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_datasets" (LIKE public."datasets") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_versions" (LIKE public."dataset_versions") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_clinical_identities" (LIKE public."clinical_identities") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_source_records" (LIKE public."dataset_source_records") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_identity_evidence" (LIKE public."identity_evidence") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_version_sources" (LIKE public."dataset_version_sources") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_split_assignments" (LIKE public."dataset_split_assignments") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_split_statistics" (LIKE public."dataset_split_statistics") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_split_validation_checks" (LIKE public."dataset_split_validation_checks") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_splits" (LIKE public."dataset_splits") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_materializations" (LIKE public."dataset_materializations") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_materialization_activations" (LIKE public."dataset_materialization_activations") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_dataset_split_images" (LIKE public."dataset_split_images") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_roles" (LIKE public."roles") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_users" (LIKE public."users") ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE "dbv24_src_user_roles" (LIKE public."user_roles") ON COMMIT DROP

LOCK TABLE public."dataset_versions", public."datasets", public."roles", public."users", public."clinical_identities", public."dataset_materializations", public."dataset_split_statistics", public."dataset_split_validation_checks", public."dataset_splits", public."dataset_version_sources", public."user_roles", public."dataset_materialization_activations", public."dataset_source_records", public."dataset_split_images", public."dataset_split_assignments", public."identity_evidence" IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

INSERT INTO public."dataset_versions" ("id", "name", "semantic_version", "status", "grouping_strategy", "grouping_field", "stratification_strategy", "split_algorithm", "split_algorithm_version", "random_seed", "target_train_ratio", "target_val_ratio", "target_test_ratio", "positive_class", "class_mapping", "source_record_count", "methodology_json", "created_at", "generated_at", "validated_at", "frozen_at", "archived_at")
SELECT "id", "name", "semantic_version", CASE WHEN status='FROZEN' THEN 'VALIDATED' ELSE status END, "grouping_strategy", "grouping_field", "stratification_strategy", "split_algorithm", "split_algorithm_version", "random_seed", "target_train_ratio", "target_val_ratio", "target_test_ratio", "positive_class", "class_mapping", "source_record_count", "methodology_json", "created_at", "generated_at", "validated_at", "frozen_at", "archived_at" FROM pg_temp.dbv24_src_dataset_versions

INSERT INTO public."datasets" ("id", "name", "source", "version", "description", "total_images", "num_classes", "class_names", "class_distribution", "license", "url", "local_path", "checksum", "created_at", "metadata", "provider", "source_type", "source_reference", "source_version")
SELECT "id", "name", "source", "version", "description", "total_images", "num_classes", "class_names", "class_distribution", "license", "url", "local_path", "checksum", "created_at", "metadata", "provider", "source_type", "source_reference", "source_version" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_datasets"

INSERT INTO public."roles" ("id", "name", "created_at")
SELECT "id", "name", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_roles" WHERE id IN (SELECT role_id FROM pg_temp.dbv24_src_user_roles)

INSERT INTO public."users" ("id", "username", "email", "password_hash", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "last_login_at", "disabled_at")
SELECT "id", "username", "email", "password_hash", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "last_login_at", "disabled_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_users"

INSERT INTO public."clinical_identities" ("id", "dataset_id", "identity_type", "source_identifier", "status", "metadata", "created_at", "updated_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_id", "identity_type", "source_identifier", "status", "metadata", "created_at", "updated_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_clinical_identities"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_materializations" ("id", "dataset_version_id", "attempt_number", "status", "reconciliation_status", "relative_root", "record_count", "manifest_metadata", "started_at", "completed_at", "failure_reason", "metadata", "created_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_version_id", "attempt_number", "status", "reconciliation_status", "relative_root", "record_count", "manifest_metadata", "started_at", "completed_at", "failure_reason", "metadata", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_materializations"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_split_statistics" ("id", "dataset_version_id", "scope", "metric_name", "numeric_value", "text_value", "details_json", "computed_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_version_id", "scope", "metric_name", "numeric_value", "text_value", "details_json", "computed_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_split_statistics"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_split_validation_checks" ("id", "dataset_version_id", "check_name", "status", "observed_value", "expected_value", "details_json", "blocking_for_validation", "blocking_for_freeze", "executed_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_version_id", "check_name", "status", "observed_value", "expected_value", "details_json", "blocking_for_validation", "blocking_for_freeze", "executed_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_split_validation_checks"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_splits" ("id", "dataset_id", "split_name", "num_samples", "class_distribution", "split_strategy", "random_seed", "created_at", "metadata")
SELECT "id", "dataset_id", "split_name", "num_samples", "class_distribution", "split_strategy", "random_seed", "created_at", "metadata" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_splits"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_version_sources" ("dataset_version_id", "dataset_id", "role", "created_at")
SELECT "dataset_version_id", "dataset_id", "role", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_version_sources"

INSERT INTO public."user_roles" ("user_id", "role_id", "created_at")
SELECT "user_id", "role_id", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_user_roles"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_materialization_activations" ("id", "dataset_version_id", "materialization_id", "dataset_family", "activated_at", "deactivated_at", "metadata")
SELECT "id", "dataset_version_id", "materialization_id", "dataset_family", "activated_at", "deactivated_at", "metadata" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_materialization_activations"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_source_records" ("id", "dataset_id", "clinical_identity_id", "source_record_key", "tfds_index", "source_filename", "class_index", "class_name", "original_label", "project_label", "relative_source_key", "source_file_sha256", "decoded_pixel_sha256", "image_width", "image_height", "file_size_bytes", "identity_status", "metadata", "created_at", "updated_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_id", "clinical_identity_id", "source_record_key", "tfds_index", "source_filename", "class_index", "class_name", "original_label", "project_label", "relative_source_key", "source_file_sha256", "decoded_pixel_sha256", "image_width", "image_height", "file_size_bytes", "identity_status", "metadata", "created_at", "updated_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_source_records"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_split_images" ("image_id", "dataset_id", "dataset_name", "dataset_source", "dataset_dir", "split_name", "class_index", "class_name", "relative_path", "absolute_path", "filename", "original_tfds_label", "project_label", "label_mapping_version", "image_width", "image_height", "file_size_bytes", "checksum_sha256", "created_at", "updated_at", "metadata", "dataset_version_id", "dataset_materialization_id")
SELECT "image_id", "dataset_id", "dataset_name", "dataset_source", "dataset_dir", "split_name", "class_index", "class_name", "relative_path", "absolute_path", "filename", "original_tfds_label", "project_label", "label_mapping_version", "image_width", "image_height", "file_size_bytes", "checksum_sha256", "created_at", "updated_at", "metadata", "dataset_version_id", "dataset_materialization_id" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_split_images"

INSERT INTO public."dataset_split_assignments" ("id", "dataset_version_id", "source_record_id", "clinical_identity_id", "split_name", "class_index", "class_name", "metadata", "created_at")
SELECT "id", "dataset_version_id", "source_record_id", "clinical_identity_id", "split_name", "class_index", "class_name", "metadata", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_dataset_split_assignments"

INSERT INTO public."identity_evidence" ("id", "source_record_id", "clinical_identity_id", "evidence_type", "evidence_level", "mapping_method", "evidence_reference", "official_source_reference", "evidence_json", "created_at")
SELECT "id", "source_record_id", "clinical_identity_id", "evidence_type", "evidence_level", "mapping_method", "evidence_reference", "official_source_reference", "evidence_json", "created_at" FROM pg_temp."dbv24_src_identity_evidence"
UPDATE public.dataset_versions AS d SET status=s.status FROM pg_temp.dbv24_src_dataset_versions AS s WHERE d.id=s.id AND s.status='FROZEN' AND d.status='VALIDATED'
SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE
COMMIT
